notes:
In BC, the Pacific Post Partum Support Society offers free phone support with postpartum counsellors, Monday to Friday, 10 am to 3 pm Pacific Time, at 604-255-7999 or toll-free at 855-255-7999. Its text line is open 10:30 am to 2:30 pm. Phone support is open to anyone who is pregnant or parenting a child under 3, and no referral is needed. The society's counsellors also give information and referrals, which can help you find a therapist.

HealthLink BC points to Healthy Families BC (Coping with Postpartum Depression and Anxiety) and to BC Women's Hospital's self-care program for women with postpartum depression and anxiety. HealthLink BC also says to talk to your doctor to find a support group in your area.

If you are in crisis, the Pacific Post Partum Support Society's site says to call the BC Mental Health Line at 310-6789, go to your local emergency department, or call 911.
